class.name: ScenarioScriptCabinImplementation
class.brief_description: How the scenario scripts reach the cabs.
class.description: The cab layer a scenario script manipulates through [code]maszyna.cabin[/code]. Implemented next to the cab layer (the demo's [code]CabinScriptImplementation[/code] forwards to [code]CabinSystem[/code]) and attached with [method ScenarioScriptServer.context_attach_cabin_implementation].

method.name: _act
method.description: Manipulates a control of the vehicle's cab - [param action] is [code]increase[/code], [code]decrease[/code], [code]hold[/code], [code]release[/code], [code]toggle[/code] or [code]set[/code]. Returns what the control answered.

method.name: _get_controls
method.description: The ids of the cab's controls.

signal.name: control_changed
signal.description: Emitted by the implementation when a control of a cab changed; the scripts subscribed to the vehicle hear of it.
